data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure (open hotel search, type destination and pick suggestion, choose dates, adjust rooms/guests with Increment then Update, search, then filter and sort), but it models guests as a single guest_count instead of rooms_guests, and it puts the rooms/guests step before Search where the true sequence did it after. It also leaves the filters vague, though it does name parameters for every varying input, so an automation could be built from it.
